headline.note: All 312 render non-blank. 304 pass the full browser render+play+controls gate; 8 are input-driven or slow/intermittent-shader primitives the static browser gate cannot capture but whose motion+controls are proven green by the Animatable contract vitest. Zero genuine functional failures; zero code fixes.

artReview.method: 15 parallel fresh-context reviewer subagents over per-category contact sheets + per-tile frames; 34 shader/edge-flagged tiles re-captured on the REAL Metal GPU (webgpu) and re-judged.

brokenReclassified.okNote: Flagged broken under SwiftShader/at a sparse capture phase; render correctly on the real Metal GPU (plasma=vivid, nebula=cloud structure, supernova=burst orb, sparkle-glints=glint field, parallax-layers=depth-layer separation by design, bounce=card in-frame, collision-balls=renders but sparse).

artReview.fixNote: Every art-flagged tile still RENDERS (non-blank), PLAYS (uniforms advance — contract vitest green), and its CONTROLS work. None meet the FIX bar (does-not-render / does-not-play / control-does-nothing / contract-or-tsc regression). All are art-polish, carried to the dedicated art-polish step.
